policy: Only player/client-visible stock MajorMUD behavior receives Classic parity credit. Raw imported binaries remain local-only.

native_break.break_dispatch: The native BREAK branch tests _is_inside_autocombat, optionally calls _display_autocombat_broken(user,1), then calls _kill_autocombat(user,1). It does not call _kill_autocombat_against.

kill_autocombat.ownership: Per-user. The routine scans 0x226 autocombat owner slots and clears only entries equal to the requested user id by writing -1.

kill_autocombat_against.ownership: Separate routine. It iterates users, tests whether each user is autocombatting against the supplied target, then calls _kill_autocombat on those matching users.

reforged_0352.pve: BREAK disables only PlayerAutocombatActive. The live NPC encounter and threat ownership remain, allowing the NPC to continue attacking. ATTACK on the same engaged NPC re-enables only the character's autocombat.
reforged_0352.pvp: Each PvP participant now has an independent autocombat-active flag and attack type. BREAK clears only the issuing participant; the opponent remains active and can continue attacking. If both participants independently break, the empty encounter can close.
reforged_0352.client_borin: The shared Classic parser tracks local autocombat separately from incoming combat danger. *Combat Off* turns local autocombat off; a later incoming hit or miss restores InCombat without turning autocombat back on. Client automatic offense stays suppressed until autocombat is explicitly re-engaged.
reforged_0352.megamud: MegaMUD continues to use stock BREAK and stock terminal markers. No private compatibility protocol is introduced.
